title: Tidal to ban and remove millions of AI-generated tracks as AI slop inundates music streaming
summary: The company said it will still accept songs that were made with AI assistance, but not fully generated.
reason: Tidal banning/removing AI-generated tracks is a platform content policy change, not a model release, research, financing/M&A/partnership/product launch, government policy action, or OSS tooling release. No active rule covers it.
